papers_and_supporting_note.scope: For each prescribed real-coefficient continuous actual-PC positive-at-infinity reference on a product of two nonempty finite embedded balanced rational pure graphs with positive real weights and rank-one positive relation cones, every bounded continuous real-PA rational-domain obstacle has an actual rational-domain PAPC uniformly decreasing regularizable raw envelope with complete contact iff at least one factor is unbranched. If both factors branch, every prescribed real reference admits a nonnegative compact bounded obstacle, unchanged reference at infinity, an exact actual PAPC raw envelope and full contact integral -8*epsilon^2*a*b<0. Actual saturated lattices, all valences, cycles, ends, full lines and disconnected components retained. The arbitrary-balanced-pair classification, literal integral-slope coefficient convention and analytic realization are not settled.
